gtpc_listen_ip.description: IP address for listening to GTP-C (signaling) traffic from SGSNs.

gtpu_listen_ip.description: IP address for listening to GTP-U (user-plane) traffic from SGSNs.

gtpu_listen_port.description: UDP port for GTP-U user-plane traffic (standard: 2152).

peers.description: List of upstream/downstream peers (GGSNs or SGSNs) to proxy traffic to/from.

type.description: Peer type: 'sgsn' or 'ggsn'. Used for routing context. Optional.

teid_range_start.description: Start of TEID range assigned to this peer (e.g., 0x10000000). Optional.

teid_range_end.description: End of TEID range assigned to this peer (e.g., 0x1FFFFFFF). Optional.

description.description: Human-readable description of the peer (for documentation).

log_color.description: Enable ANSI color codes in console logs (true/false).

stats_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between logging of statistics summary (0 disables).

realm.description: Authentication/routing realm (e.g., 'mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org'). Optional; used in multi-operator deployments.
